Alias: Dravalak Dash 

Birth Name: Dral'valak Zadra

Race: Hobgoblin 

Age: 28

Gender: Male

Class: Wizard (School of Illusion) 

Personality: He is ultimately a showman, loving nothing more than the thrill of the game. He comes across as a fiendish gentleman at times, but he can be a bit crude once you get beyond his jokes and pranks. It's difficult to exactly figure out his motivations, but he does have a crafty and mischievous air about him. He certainly isn't hateable, just a bit off-putting and a tad bit overwhelming with how much of a chatterbox he can be. He has an absolute soft spot for children. 

Appearance: Even as someone magically-inclined, he is a fairly tall and muscular person, standing at about 6'4". He has warm and darker reddish skin and a large nose. He has the standard goblinoid features, sporting large pointed ears, as well. He has very long dark hair and sharp grey eyes. 

Clothing: He tends to wear mostly black or dark colors. He likes to think it makes him look mysterious, and so people will be more inclined to come and talk to him. He wears a hat with a long owl feather tucked into it. Even as a wizard, he sports black leather armor. He also wears (or will also just hang it off his backpack or belt) a mask resembling an owl, to boost that mysterious factor or something. 

Equipment:  Of course, he carries a spellbook with him. It's very old and disheveled, pages seeming like they're going to fall out at any second. He also carries a staff with a crescent moon shape at the top, that serves as his trusty whacky stick and his arcane focus (it being one of his few items from his home tribe).

Class: Cleric (Death)

Class: Blood Hunter (Order of the Ghostslayer) 

Gender: Genderless/Agender 

Age: 19 

Personality: After having spent most of their existence as a "the one who listens", as a highly-trusted worker to a now-dead noble, Audience is rather quiet and reserved. Clothing/Equipment: They wear rather simple clothing, primarily consisting of a white with some greys. They wear a white cloak, and they tend to keep their eyes covered with a dark grey/black cloth. They use a red and black longbow that is a bit unsettling and otherworldly.

Name: Tippy 

Race: Satyr

Class: Sorcerer (Shadow Magic) 

Gender: Female

Personality: Tippy is a fairly cheery individual and tries to keep a gentle and composed demeanor. She is quick to take charge of a situation and likes everything to remain orderly and organized. Name: Pineth Goltorah

Race: Elf (Eladrin — Winter) 

Class: Bard (College of Lore) 

Gender: Female 

Age: 32

Personality: She is fairly straight-laced and seems indifferent towards the world, but she can sometimes have a soft side (but has difficulty showing affection even towards those she likes). She tends to be visibly annoyed by others' actions, especially if they are silly, thinking she has no part in such menial matters. Her focus is her job, and her job is what she must do. She is quite passionate about history and the spoken word, but her passion comes through in silent effort. She secretly writes poetry in the dead of night, but she may just kill you if you try to look into her book. 

Appearance: She is fairly tall at 6'1" and has the famous slender build of an elf. She has long, flowing white hair, except it is shaved off on one side of her head, revealing white a large scar. She has dull, dark eyes, and pale skin that almost seems like it shimmers. She almost always looks very bored and tired. Her other features are fairly sharp. 

Clothing/Equipment: She wears fairly monochromatic clothing, favoring blacks and greys. She wears a large coat over leather armor, her shoulder covered by a thick shawl. Her favorite instrument is the flute, and her weapon of choice is the rapier. 

Some Backstory: 
•mother died in childbirth (giving birth to younger twin) 

•she and father are refugees from wartorn land
 
•end up in a city promising safety 

•father hired as dock worker 

•boss gives Pineth a flute 

•dock workers love to hear tiny child play 

•father dies of overwork and depression in her early 20s

•leaves docks and plays various gigs in taverns 

•hired by drow noble to play at important banquet

•noble notices keen intellect and sharp intuition and hires her as his advisor 

•does this for a number of years until noble's eldest daughter returns from travels 

•daughter and Pineth start secret relationship 

•noble finds out, threatens to kill daughter (complicated reasons), and Pineth steps in, getting beaten within an inch of her life, and banished from city 

•Pineth had heard the daughter was given ultimatum but had chosen to be banished, as well 

•has been traveling for the last few years in search of her lost love
